source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        background = max(set(row), key=row.count)
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == background and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] != background:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
